Seeing this game again makes me feel all warm and nostalgic, Final Fantasy X was one of my favourite Final Fantasy games ever.
I have just listened to the Final Fantasy X - Will - audio drama, my opinion: What the flute!?!?!? I guess Square Enix really have never heard of the phrase "When you're in a hole, stop digging!"
But to be fair, out of all of Final Fantasy X's sequels this was the best one: Final Fantasy X-2 was just a load of Shoopuff, even to this day I'm still trying to erase its existence frommy mind, Last Mission made me want to rip my eyes out and the one between Last Mission and Will made me want to hang myself over a cliff. I liked the return of Sin, but I was really disappointed with the characters reactions to it, it was like a poorly written fanfiction, and Icouldn't stand the new characters of Chuami and Kurgam, made mecwant torip my ears off!
If Square Enix do decide to follow up Will with a Final Fantasy X-3then they really need to pull their fingers out - their recent games have been a load of shite so if they ruin the "franchise" of Final Fantasy X any more than they have done then I'll be majorly pissed since Final Fantasy X is one of my favourite Final Fantasy games of all time. If Final Fantasy X-3 does take off it would be the perfect opportunity for Square Enix to redeem themselves, I just hope they don't f**k it up!
One scene I have always wanted to seein Final Fantasy X which never happened was Tidus showing Yuna "his" Zanarkand: I'd love to see it in Final Fantasy X-3 as they could use the setting of Zanarkand for Tidus and Yunato rekindle thrir love as it would, ironically, reflect their love scene inFinal Fantasy X...but from the way things are going that's not going to happen, Square Enix don't seem to be paying hardly, if any, attention to their fanbase.
So, for now, the remaining fans of Final Fantasy are going to have to tolerate with the lunacy of Square Enix for as long as they continue to be money-grabbing soul-crushing nincompoops! 
Bring back Hironobu Sakaguchi! Save Final Fantasy, be a Hiro!!!

stories.author: @Codemaster92163
stories.text:
This song has a new association for me, now. 

I would play through FFX every few years or so, and on my most recent playthrough, I lost my cat. Not just A cat, but one of the sweetest, most affectionate and wonderful animals I've ever had the pleasure of owning. She went missing and never came back, right towards the end of my most recent playthrough. And not missing as in someone else got her, but missing as in we're pretty certain wild coy dogs got her.

It was a really difficult time, but oddly enough, the themes of the game and the challenges they all deal with helped to ground me and remind myself that death is just a part of life. Everyone in that game lost someone, and they kept going, so it helped remind me that I'd be alright and move on with my grief. 

So, this song made me cry today when listening. I don't know if I'll ever be able to play the game again, because anything in it reminds me of her, but I will always love it and appreciate how it helped me cope with death, even if some people don't consider the death of a beloved pet as significant.

stories.author: @letalleurkevin5133
stories.text:
It was 2001. I was 11 years old. You can't imagine just how mind-blowing that opening scene was. The console gaming market was entering its golden age; competition was fierce, but when SquareSoft released Final Fantasy X, they completely obliterated the competition. A colleague's older brother was working at Ubisoft on a game called Beyond Good & Evil. When Square dropped the trailer featuring that cinematic, there was dead silence in the studio the next day. Everyone was stunned by the sheer technical leap. Their game was due out at the end of the year. They ended up starting almost from scratch because the release of FFX had rendered two years of their work graphically obsolete. They weren't the only ones, either; some studios had to completely change their approach to game design. Final Fantasy X thus marked the beginning of the "graphics arms race... a trend that, unfortunately, led to a homogenization of design by the end of the 2000s.

It’s crazy to think just how unrivaled Square was in the early 2000s (to the point where even Disney tried to piggyback on their hype) and then to see how they managed to squander the gold mine they were sitting on. There’s a parallel universe where SquareSoft acquires Marvel in 2008 and Star Wars in 2013, and where the PlayStation 5 is called the "SquareStation 2" following a merger with Sony in 2006. Even though Square remains one of the biggest studios, it pales in comparison to what they could have become had it not been for a cascade of bad decisions. Any other company would have gone under long ago. In that sense, the existence of the FFVII Remake trilogy is nothing short of a miracle...

But then things in my personal life went very awry, like not even a month later, and kinda started a continuous struggle with depression. Keep in mind i was only like 13, but in a weird way, this song now seems like the last song of my childhood innocence, in a way. I’ve had to deal with a lot of shit since I’ve been born, but I still had a sense of optimism. It’s crazy how music can be intrinsically tied with emotional moments of your life, but that’s the power of music, wether it’s good or bad, it can bring us back in time to moments that can forever change how you are and what that can lead to.

stories.author: @FiendMatadorSlayerOfNoobs
stories.text:
Man, oh man. I was 10 years old when I got to this, on a snowy, lit up December in 2001- My cousin had bought a PS2 and 3 games: Wrath of Cortex, Sons of Liberty, and Final Fantasy X.

I was a scrawny little kid from a non-English speaking country, who pieced together what little my brain could just from context, events and associating certain phrases & words, and my really badly-managed Sphere Grid..


But dang, this music made me bawl from how beautiful it was. My father legit thought I had hurt myself while playing. I still remember how he had this small laugh before he gave me a big hug during the violin part and asked me if the "movie" was sad.

Heh, he was awestruck when I told him it was a video game. After that, he would sit down and watch me play on occasion, and since he actually could speak an okay amount of English, he would translate stuff I didn't understand in the cutscenes. Shit, I love my childhood.

stories.author: @Kalendil
stories.text: I never, ever thought that I could cry over a game until I played FFX. I was 25 years old when I was able to bought my own PS2 (13 years ago). Because I loved Fanatasy, I bought that game... and it was INCREDIBLE. The story, de sound, the animations... I was in love with the game.  And at the end... I couldn't stop crying. I remembered that when I started to figure Tidus's fate out I was like: no, no, no no no no NO! COME ON! It broke my heart. How I wish this story turned out in a book or a movie so I can treasure it forever.

stories.author: @しょっくん-w7x
stories.text:
SUTEKI DANE / RIKKI

【Verse 1】
Words the wind carried in,
my heart drifted along.
Voices leaping with hope
for tomorrow the clouds will bring.

In the moonlit mirror,
my trembling heart sways.
As the stars fall away,
soft tears spill down my face.

Wouldn’t it be wonderful…
if we could somehow walk hand in hand,
I’d want to go
to your town, your home, into your arms.

I’ll lay myself on your chest,
lose myself in the dusk,
and dream.


【Verse 2】
The wind falls still,
and words fade into gentle illusions.
The clouds break apart,
and tomorrow becomes a distant voice.

My heart drifts through
a mirror blurred by the moon.
As the stars tremble,
tears I can’t hide spill over.

Wouldn’t it be wonderful…
if we could somehow walk hand in hand,
I’d want to go
to your town, your home, into your arms.

I’d softly reach out
and touch your face,
melting into the morning,
and dream.

stories.author: @CinemaSquad89
stories.text:
Hi, Rinoabelle.
It’s been seven years since we last saw each other.
This was our last song while cruising down the road, with you resting on my lap.

I know you have a family now. I’m sorry for how things ended back then. I just want you to know that I’m always proud of you, and I’m happy for where you are now.

Who would’ve thought that would be our last moment, right?

Thank you for the beautiful memories

stories.text:
Never beat the game.
 I bought the game when it first came out. Was very excited. Played it and got to the final part. I decided to do side quests before fighting Sin.
I then visited a friend, and this guy spoils the ending without me asking. I felt so devastated and disgusted that I refused to keep playing the game, felt that an experience and moment was taken from me.
Well its been over 20 years now and on the journey of playing the game again after I'm done with some of the earlier Final Fantasy titles. 
I have to find conclusion with this game. Its going to be weird me saying this, but I don't want to pass away before finishing this game. 
Every time i see a FFX clip or hear this song it makes me cry.

stories.author: @dizzitoast
stories.text:
Not a true translation. But poetic reinterpretation:

Words carried by the wind
set my heart adrift.

Tomorrow, borne on the clouds,
made my voice leap with hope.

In the mirror where the moon trembles,
my heart quivered.

As the stars flowed and spilled,
soft tears fell.

⸻

Isn’t it beautiful?

If only the two of us
could walk hand in hand.

I want to go…

to your town,

your home,

into your arms.

⸻

There,

I rest my body

against your heart,

hidden within the evening,

dreaming.

⸻

The wind grows still.

The words become

a gentle illusion.

The clouds break apart.

Tomorrow

becomes a distant voice.

⸻

The mirror blurred by the moon

carries away my heart.

The stars tremble,

overflowing—

tears

I can no longer hide.

⸻

Isn’t it beautiful?

If only the two of us
could walk hand in hand.

I want to go…

to your town,

your home,

into your arms.

⸻

To gently touch

your face…

dreaming

until the dream melts

into the morning.

stories.text: im 46 and im tearing up right now remembering the greatness of this game. just seeing the ending scene where Yuna runs at Tidus only to fall thru him as she wants to hold on to him. stories.author: @Todai_sitsugyo
stories.text:
English subtitle(Not official and only part1)

Written by one Japanese man


Words borne on the wind,
my heart drifted.

Toward tomorrow on the clouds,
my voice leapt.

In a mirror trembling with the moon,
my heart quivered.

As stars streamed by,
soft tears spilled.

How lovely it would be
if we could walk hand in hand.

I wish I could go
to your town, your home, your arms.

Against your heart,
lost in the dusk,
I dream.
